instructions: Fill in the `question` field of every entry, then run:
The runner refuses to start while any entry still contains the placeholder marker «.
Ask about things YOU know the answer to - the value of this eval is that you can judge the answer.
`note` is free space for what you expect; it is stored with the result and never sent to the model.
Categories (one per entry, all six should be represented):
single_fact_recall       one fact, stated once - 'what did I decide about X'
timeline_reasoning       several messages in order - 'how did X change over time'
speaker_attribution      who said or did it - 'who recommended X to me', 'what did A say about B'
multi_source_synthesis   needs two chunks joined - 'is A the same person as B', 'what changed and why'
abstention               the record does NOT contain it - 'what is the name of X'; a good answer declines
older_memory             the fact is far back in the history - a real recency test

questions.question: «fill in: a fact stated once in your history»
«fill in: something that changed over weeks or months»
«fill in: who said or did something»
«fill in: needs two or more messages joined»
«fill in: something your history genuinely does NOT contain»
questions.note: a good answer declines instead of inventing
